_about: IndieHR (P1-T1d, Q-T9): every browser storage key the web app uses, classified. Read by tests-ihr/lib/storage.ts (what may stay after sign-out) and by scripts/check-storage-keys.py (every key in apps/frontend/src is listed here or cleared by clearStaffStorage). A key that is neither fails both until it is reviewed. 'may_remain' keys hold no person, patient or token.

exact.care_login_preference: staff or patient tab on the sign-in page
exact.care_schedule_service_type: which resource type the schedule screen shows
exact.care_queue_service_points: service-point ids chosen on the queue screen
exact.care_queues_preferred_service_point_cate: service-point category chosen on the queue screen
exact.encounter-command-dialog-recent-actions: names of app actions, not patients
exact.patient_identifier_filter_search_type: which identifier type to search by
exact.ihr_sign_out_pending: "1" until the backend confirms a sign-out (staffSession.ts)
